turns.q: How long does it normally take to ship and send a tracking number?

p and send a tracking number?

Orders are processed within 24 hours of receipt for orders placed Sunday through Thursday, while orders received on Friday and Saturday are processed on Monday.
Overall, please allow 48–72 hours for processing and for tracking information to be sent out in a shipping confirmation email.
Once shipped, standard shipping takes 10–14 business days, and priority shipping takes 7–10 business days. Is there anything else I can help you with?
